arc: hook (prompt typed and sent → app card) → proof (card folds into a wall of builder sites) → stat ×3 → announcement ($400M Series C count-up) → stat (valuation + investor lines) → logo (mark, wordmark, tagline, URL)

scenes.title: Prompt box types a request, send is clicked, an app card builds itself
scenes.summary: On a warm creme background with drifting orange/blue/pink glows, the eyebrow 'IDEA TO APP IN SECONDS' fades up. A white rounded prompt input springs in with the placeholder 'Ask Lovable to create a website…', then 'Build me a booking site for my bakery' types out with a moving caret; '+' and 'Public' chips sit below and the round send button turns black. At frame 60 the send is pressed (scale dip, expanding ring, mouse-click sound), the box lifts away, and a large app card rises from below and builds itself: gradient header band, then skeleton text lines, then button pills.
scenes.build: Pure React with inline styles: typed = floor((frame − 12) × 0.85) slices the prompt string, caret is a 4px span solid while typing and blinking at rest. spring()/interpolate() from @genmotion/motion drive box in/out, press, ring and card rise; <Sequence from={60}><Audio src={click}/></Sequence> syncs the click. The card is components/AppCard.tsx, whose `build` prop (0..1) staggers heading → body lines → button in via show(k). Lucide icons Plus/Globe/ArrowUp.
scenes.reuse: Ideal opener for any AI builder, prompt-to-result or 'type a request' product: change PROMPT, the placeholder, chip labels and eyebrow. HERO_CARD is exported so the next scene can open on the identical card; keep that handoff pattern. Replace the Lovable copy and the click sound to taste.

scenes.title: Hero card folds into a centre-out wall of self-building site cards
scenes.summary: Scene 1's app card shrinks and fades while a 6×4 grid of abstract website cards (gradient header, skeleton lines, button pills) pops in from the centre outward, each landing empty and then building itself, all slowly bobbing and drifting. A creme scrim fades over the wall, 'SINCE NOVEMBER 2024' fades up as an eyebrow, and the two-line headline 'Millions of people / built their own websites.' rises line by line and breathes.
scenes.build: components/CardGrid.tsx holds the work: fixed jittered cells ranked by distance from frame centre, each revealing at revealStart + rank × each, with a delayed `build` passed to AppCard and a sine bob tied to the continuous frame. The scene adds the shrinking handoff card (HERO_CARD from 01-idea), an rgba creme scrim interpolated to WALL_SCRIM, and TextAnimation presets fadeUp / lineRise with hold="breathe".
scenes.reuse: Use whenever you need 'lots of users / sites / things made with us' as an image: swap AppCard for your own thumbnail (or screenshots), retune COLS/ROWS and stagger, and change the eyebrow and headline. The centre-out ripple reveal plus scrim-behind-headline is the reusable recipe. The card content is abstract shapes, so it needs no brand assets.

scenes.title: Three count-up stats over the card wall, then a spectrum band wipe
scenes.summary: Over the scrimmed, still-drifting card wall, a row of three stats separated by hairline dividers rises in with a stagger and counts up: '60M' projects built, '900M' monthly visits, '65%' of the Fortune 500, each label fading up word by word and floating. The stats lift out at frame 84 and a 96px full-spectrum gradient band (yellow→orange→red→pink→violet→blue) wipes left to right across the middle as the handoff.
scenes.build: STATS array mapped to columns; <CountText to suffix startFrom duration> does the counting and TextAnimation fadeUp with hold="float" the labels. The wall is <CardGrid frame={frame + 150} revealStart={-4000}/> so it is fully built and its drift continues seamlessly across the cut from scene 2. The wipe is an overflow-hidden div whose width interpolates 0→1920 over a fixed-width gradFull band.
scenes.reuse: A clean metrics row for any milestone or fundraising video: edit the three STATS entries (to, suffix, label). Works without the wall behind it (drop CardGrid and the scrim). The band wipe is a handy branded transition into a hero number.

scenes.title: Spectrum band gathers into an underline under a $400M count-up
scenes.summary: The full-width gradient band from scene 3 contracts into a 12px rounded underline centred low in frame. 'SERIES C' fades up char by char as an eyebrow, then '$400M' counts up at 220px hero size, deblurring and rising in with a soft pink bloom behind it and a gentle breathe. 'Led by Menlo Ventures and the Scaleup Europe Fund' blurs up word by word beneath. Everything blurs out upward and the underline opens back out into a thin full-width divider near the top for the next scene.
scenes.build: The band is one div whose left/top/width/height/borderRadius are all interpolated through the same key frames [6, 30, 116, 134] (full band → pill underline → hold → thin divider), so the shape morphs instead of cutting. <CountText to={400} prefix="$" suffix="M"> for the number with interpolated blur filter in/out; TextAnimation by="char" fadeUp and by="word" blurUp.
scenes.reuse: The go-to 'we raised $X' frame: change the CountText target/prefix/suffix, the round eyebrow and the lead-investor line. The morphing gradient band that bridges scenes 3→4→5 is worth copying as a connective device; replace gradFull with your brand gradient.

scenes.title: $13.3B valuation count-up with two lines of backers, mark rises
scenes.summary: The thin gradient divider sits near the top while '$13.3B' counts up at 176px, deblurring in, with 'VALUATION' as a char-by-char eyebrow below. Two centred lines of backers blur up: 'Accel · Balderton · CapitalG · DST Global · Tencent' and 'Salesforce Ventures · HubSpot Ventures · Kaszek · World Innovation Lab'. The number and text blur out, the divider slides off the top, and the Lovable heart mark springs up at centre as the handoff.
scenes.build: Same recipe as scene 4: CountText with decimals={1}, interpolated blur/translate in and out, TextAnimation by="line" blurUp for the investor names. The mark is an of assets/lovable-mark.svg sprung in at frame 98; MARK {size, cy} is exported so scene 6 opens on it at the identical size.
scenes.reuse: Use for a valuation or second-number beat with a typed-out investor/customer list; swap the target, label and the two name lines. Investor names are plain text, so no logo files are needed. Near-identical structure to 04-series-c, so pick one if you only need one big number.

scenes.title: Mark settles up, wordmark blurs in, tagline then URL
scenes.summary: The Lovable mark arrives at scene 5's size in the centre and settles up and smaller over a pulsing orange glow, breathing gently. 'Lovable' blurs up char by char at 124px beneath it, the tagline 'Idea to app in seconds' blurs in word by word and exits, then 'LOVABLE.DEV' fades in letter by letter in the same spot as an eyebrow.
scenes.build: Interpolated size/cy for the mark from MARK (imported from 05-valuation) to its final position; sine-driven breathe and glow opacity; TextAnimation blurUp by char and by word with Sequence-bounded exit, then a fadeIn by char for the URL.
scenes.reuse: Simple light end card: replace the SVG mark, wordmark text, tagline and URL. Fine as a closer for any warm/minimal brand.
